Legal asked me to surface a quick request from our marketing team: we would like to have a narrow permission to use the Redwood logo and a short customer quote in a joint pilot announcement and one customer spotlight on our site.

- Can you confirm the exact quote copy and logo asset you want to use (we typically require a high-res logo and a short blurb for approval)?

Subject: Proposed redlines — limited publicity carveout + Marketing Addendum

Hi Diane / Ava,

Thanks — attached are our proposed redlines (see Redwood_MSA_Redlines_20261125.pdf). Key points summarized below so it's easier to consume:

1) Narrow scope: carveout limited to a single quote (<= 45 words) and logo use only in one co-branded PDF one-pager and one hosted customer spotlight page. No use in paid advertising, press releases naming sensitive integrations, or case studies disclosing PHI or internal metrics.

2) Approval workflow: Greenfield must provide final copy and logo assets for Redwood's approval; Redwood will provide approval (or consolidated comments) within 10 business days.

3) Embargo: explicit embargo date to be set on the Marketing Addendum (we'll capture Feb 15, 2027 as discussed). Any earlier release requires written sign-off from both parties.

4) Time limit: permission granted for 12 months from the date of first public posting unless otherwise extended in writing.

5) Confidentiality carveouts: we suggest a limited carveout clause in Section 10 (Confidentiality) to exclude the approved quote and logo usage from the definition of Confidential Information, but only for the expressly approved assets. All other data remains confidential.

6) IP / Trademark: Greenfield grants a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable right to use the specified logo files solely for the approved materials; trademark usage must follow Greenfield's brand guidelines (we've requested those assets via the Drive link).

I've also added a short Marketing Addendum template to be attached to the Order Form (see attached). If Greenfield is comfortable with these guardrails, we can incorporate the Addendum into the Order Form and route to contracts for signature.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_Redlines_20261125.pdf (proposed redline + Marketing Addendum template)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_marketing-assets (share requested for final logos)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/GF-2026-034

Thanks,

Monica / Ava — thanks for the clear summary and the draft. Greenfield is generally amenable to the narrow carveout as drafted, but our counsel flagged one area for revision:

- Section on Confidentiality carveout: remove any language that could be read to expand or waive confidentiality beyond the specifically approved assets. We propose clarifying that the carveout applies only to the "exact quote text" and the "exact logo file(s) approved in writing" and that no operational or technical data, metrics, or screenshots containing customer data are covered.

- Mutual indemnity: your redline introduced a mutual indemnity sentence in the Addendum; Greenfield prefers to keep the Addendum silent on indemnities and have indemnity obligations governed solely by the main MSA.

I've attached our marked-up doc (Greenfield_Publicity_Comments_20261126.docx). If Redwood can accept the two narrow edits above, Greenfield can sign the Order Form + Marketing Addendum and provide the final approved logo and quote copy.
